CustomField.description: Written by: the create leg. THREE BRANCHES, one per class of person we can know: account id plus lowercased email; or account id plus roster key where no email exists; or, for a person known only from a MENTION carrying neither, account id plus the lowercased designator as heard. Unique, so two runs over one person on one account make one row. THE THIRD BRANCH'S UNIQUENESS IS A RULING: two mentions of one spelling on one account are ONE row, because a later call saying the name again is the same person named again. The cost, stated not hidden: two different people sharing a spoken first name on one account collapse here, and the ladder's AMBIGUOUS refusal is what stops that collapse ever binding to a Contact. A misheard spelling makes its own row, which is correct: it is a different thing heard. The key is per ACCOUNT not per opportunity, because a person is one person across that account's deals; stance is per scope and lives on the Answer, identity is not.
